description: Na₃LiCuCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.63 Å. Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.61 Å. Cu is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Cu-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.57 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cu, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Cu, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Li, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Li, one Cu, and one P atom.
